crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people…
I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they…
Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy…
Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

translations.web: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
